description: Quote a buy (ETH in) or sell (token amount in) for a launch token, on the bonding curve or in the Uniswap V4 pool after graduation. Returns expected output, minimum after slippage, and fees. A reading, not a promise.

amount.description: Base units as a decimal string: wei of ETH for a buy, token base units (18 decimals) for a sell.

amountEth.description: Buy only: ETH as a decimal such as 0.01. Use instead of amount.

slippageBps.description: Slippage limit in basis points. Default 100, maximum 1000.

token.description: Symbol, name, token address, or launch address.

name: polypad_quote_trade
title: Quote a buy or sell
